# ---- relearner session 9: moves 481-540
ev .set ROM_SIZE, 0; createmon 0, 0, SPECIES_MEW, 100; special CalculatePlayerPartyCount; end

waitpmem 8 move_relearner:sMoveRelearnerStruct 0 4 900
waitquiet
